source.content: @isTest private class DatabaseDmlFrontierEvidenceTest { private static Integer seq = 0; private static Account row(String stem) { seq++; Account account = new Account(Name = stem + ' ' + seq); insert account; return account; } private static void assertMerged(Database.MergeResult result) { System.assert(result.isSuccess()); System.assertNotEquals(null, result.getId()); System.assertEquals(1, result.getMergedRecordIds().size()); } private static void assertMergedList(List<Database.MergeResult> results) { System.assertEquals(1, results.size()); assertMerged(results[0]); } @isTest static void dmlFamiliesRunLocally() { Database.SaveResult inserted = Database.insert(new Account(Name = 'Family Insert')); System.assert(inserted.isSuccess()); Database.SaveResult updated = Database.update(new Account(Id = inserted.getId(), Name = 'Family Update')); System.assert(updated.isSuccess()); Database.DeleteResult deleted = Database.delete(new Account(Id = inserted.getId())); System.assert(deleted.isSuccess()); Database.UndeleteResult undeleted = Database.undelete(new Account(Id = inserted.getId())); System.assert(undeleted.isSuccess()); Database.LockResult locked = Database.lock(new Account(Id = inserted.getId())); System.assert(locked.isSuccess()); Database.UnlockResult unlocked = Database.unlock(new Account(Id = inserted.getId())); System.assert(unlocked.isSuccess()); Database.UpsertResult upserted = Database.upsert(new Account(Name = 'Family Upsert')); System.assert(upserted.isSuccess()); Account purge = row('Family Purge'); System.assert(Database.delete(purge).isSuccess()); Database.EmptyRecycleBinResult purged = Database.emptyRecycleBin(purge); System.assert(purged.isSuccess()); List<Object> roots = new List<Object>{new Account(Name = 'Tree List One'), new Account(Name = 'Tree List Two')}; List<Database.NestedSaveResult> savedTrees = Database.treeSave(roots); System.assertEquals(2, savedTrees.size()); System.assert(savedTrees[0].isSuccess()); } @isTest static void mergeIdOverloadsRunLocally() { Account m1 = row('Merge Id Master'); Account d1 = row('Merge Id Duplicate'); assertMerged(Database.merge(new Account(Id = m1.Id, Name = 'Merge Id Done'), d1.Id)); Account m2 = row('Merge Id Access Master'); Account d2 = row('Merge Id Access Duplicate'); assertMerged(Database.merge(new Account(Id = m2.Id, Name = 'Merge Id Access Done'), d2.Id, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE)); Account m3 = row('Merge Id Bool Master'); Account d3 = row('Merge Id Bool Duplicate'); assertMerged(Database.merge(new Account(Id = m3.Id, Name = 'Merge Id Bool Done'), d3.Id, false)); Account m4 = row('Merge Id Both Master'); Account d4 = row('Merge Id Both Duplicate'); assertMerged(Database.merge(new Account(Id = m4.Id, Name = 'Merge Id Both Done'), d4.Id, false, AccessLevel.USER_MODE)); } @isTest static void mergeListIdOverloadsRunLocally() { Account m1 = row('Merge List Id Master'); Account d1 = row('Merge List Id Duplicate'); assertMergedList(Database.merge(new Account(Id = m1.Id), new List<Id>{d1.Id})); Account m2 = row('Merge List Id Access Master'); Account d2 = row('Merge List Id Access Duplicate'); assertMergedList(Database.merge(new Account(Id = m2.Id), new List<Id>{d2.Id}, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE)); Account m3 = row('Merge List Id Bool Master'); Account d3 = row('Merge List Id Bool Duplicate'); assertMergedList(Database.merge(new Account(Id = m3.Id), new List<Id>{d3.Id}, false)); Account m4 = row('Merge List Id Both Master'); Account d4 = row('Merge List Id Both Duplicate'); assertMergedList(Database.merge(new Account(Id = m4.Id), new List<Id>{d4.Id}, false, AccessLevel.USER_MODE)); } @isTest static void mergeObjectOverloadsRunLocally() { Account m1 = row('Merge Object Master'); Account d1 = row('Merge Object Duplicate'); assertMerged(Database.merge(new Account(Id = m1.Id), new Account(Id = d1.Id))); Account m2 = row('Merge Object Access Master'); Account d2 = row('Merge Object Access Duplicate'); assertMerged(Database.merge(new Account(Id = m2.Id), new Account(Id = d2.Id), AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE)); Account m3 = row('Merge Object Both Master'); Account d3 = row('Merge Object Both Duplicate'); assertMerged(Database.merge(new Account(Id = m3.Id), new Account(Id = d3.Id), false, AccessLevel.USER_MODE)); } @isTest static void mergeListObjectOverloadsRunLocally() { Account m1 = row('Merge List Object Master'); Account d1 = row('Merge List Object Duplicate'); assertMergedList(Database.merge(new Account(Id = m1.Id), new List<Object>{new Account(Id = d1.Id)})); Account m2 = row('Merge List Object Access Master'); Account d2 = row('Merge List Object Access Duplicate'); assertMergedList(Database.merge(new Account(Id = m2.Id), new List<Object>{new Account(Id = d2.Id)}, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE)); Account m3 = row('Merge List Object Bool Master'); Account d3 = row('Merge List Object Bool Duplicate'); assertMergedList(Database.merge(new Account(Id = m3.Id), new List<Object>{new Account(Id = d3.Id)}, false)); Account m4 = row('Merge List Object Both Master'); Account d4 = row('Merge List Object Both Duplicate'); assertMergedList(Database.merge(new Account(Id = m4.Id), new List<Object>{new Account(Id = d4.Id)}, false, AccessLevel.USER_MODE)); } }
